text:
marta: opened PR to tidy the Orpheus-2B model card and migration notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4291. Main goals: fix broken bench links, normalize display name vs runtime alias, and update SDK snippet to async v4.

leo: quick scan of the preview: linkcheck flagged /assets/bench/orpheus/latency.csv and an external weights URL. We should keep bench CSVs in docs/assets/bench and replace direct weight links with a provenance paragraph.

hana: noticed mixed casing. the card sometimes says 'Orpheus-2B' and examples show 'orpheus2b'. runtime mapping tolerates aliases but customers keep hitting hyphen mismatches. propose adding an "aliases" list and a clear YAML pin example.

tim: SDK snippet needs update for v4 async shape. current snippet uses resp['text'], new shape is resp['choices'][0]['message']['content']. small proposed example: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = await client.generate(model="orpheus-2b", prompt="Hello")
print(resp['choices'][0]['message']['content'])
```

infra-bot: linkcheck: 2 broken links (docs/model-sources.md#L14, /assets/bench/orpheus/latency.csv). Recommendation: copy bench CSV into docs/assets/bench/orpheus and replace external weight URL with provenance to upstream repo + license.

marta: i'll add a provenance block pointing to the upstream checkpoint repo and license text, and remove the absolute storage URL.

leo: i'll add the aliases line and a short note in the migration guide about alias vs display name. YAML pin example suggestion: ```yaml
routes:
  - model: Orpheus-2B
    aliases: [orpheus2b, orpheus-2b-int8]
    pinned_variant: orpheus2b-int8
```

hana: also please add a small "measurement methodology" subsection: sequence length, batch size, batch-window, hardware. otherwise bench numbers prompt support tickets.

marta: good point. i'll include seq_len=512, batch=8, batch_window=200ms and runner args.

tim: added the SDK snippet change in the PR and left a TODO to add a streaming example as follow-up.

infra-bot: deploy-preview built. linkcheck: 1 remaining broken link: https://storage.redwood.ai/models/orpheus/weights.tar.gz referenced in model-sources.md.

marta: removed the storage link from model-sources.md and pointed readers to the provenance block in the card instead.

hana: moved latency.csv into docs/assets/bench/orpheus and updated PR links.

doc-bot: CI passed. linkcheck clean. preview: https://deployments.preview.redwood.ai/docs/orpheus-2b-card

marta: merging after CI green. will follow up with a short note to model-onboarding about adding alias guidance to the card template. thanks for the quick help everyone. :tada:
